recovery.rule: Every UI mutation is added synchronously to the outbox before asynchronous IndexedDB flushing.

render_contract.existing_renderer_compatibility: Legacy key reads/writes are virtualized by the persistence bridge so traces-v24 can remain visually unchanged during storage cutover.

failure_modes.indexeddb_temporarily_unavailable: Continue from recovery projection, queue mutations locally, replay when DB returns.
failure_modes.tab_closes_during_write: Outbox persists synchronously and replays on next boot.
failure_modes.migration_verification_fails: Do not write verified marker; preserve legacy and recovery data; do not destructively rewrite history.

forbidden: Deleting legacy habit history during cutover
Persisting trajectory/graph values as canonical truth
Making network connectivity required for a habit tap
Reintroducing the legacy habit object as the canonical owner after verified cutover
Treating view preferences as behavior history
next: Typed migration for tracker activation dates
Optional cross-device sync after local ownership is stable
